items.title: Creating Inclusive Applications for Diverse Users (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Creating Inclusive Applications for Diverse Users (PDF 130, printed 126).

blocks.text: Inclusive applications mukhtalif qism ke users ki zarooratein poori karne ke liye design ki jati hain. Is mein aise features shamil ho sakte hain jaise nazar ki kamzori walon ke liye screen readers (screen ka text bol kar sunane wala software), videos ke liye subtitles ya kai zabanon ke options. Saada layout aur wazeh text bhi apps ko naye users ke liye aasan banate hain. Developers ko apne designs mukhtalif users ke saath test karne chahiyein ta ke sab ke liye accessibility yaqeeni ho. Inclusive digital tools banana barabari ko barhata hai aur user ka majmooi tajurba behtar karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe dabbe: Screen reader (nazar ki kamzori wale), Subtitles (videos ke saath matn), Kai zabanein (zaban ka intikhab), Saada layout (aasan istemal), Wazeh matn (parhne mein aasan), Users se testing (mukhtalif log aazmayein).
blocks.caption: Shamooliyat wali (inclusive) applications ki khoobiyan (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.prompt: Inclusive app ke teen features batayein, aur developers ko kya test karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Nazar se mehroom logon ke liye screen readers, videos ke subtitles, kai zabanon ke options (aur saada layout, wazeh text). Developers ko apna design mukhtalif qism ke users ke saath test karna chahiye.

items: Inclusive applications: har qism ke users ki zarooratein.
Screen readers, subtitles, zabanein, saada layout; mukhtalif users se testing.
